title: Events retention window is exposed only via read-only /events_retention/ endpoint, never as project fields
answers: Where do I get the events retention window for a project?
Can I add event_retention_months back to the projects API?
How does the retention banner know the retention window?
body:
The window is served by `EventsRetentionViewSet.list` in products/product_analytics/backend/presentation/events_retention.py at `GET /api/projects/:id/events_retention/`, returning `retention_months`, `retained_from`, `docs_url`.
- Do not put the window back on the project/team serializer: agents enumerating `/api/projects/:id` read it as a setting and file tickets to change it (that is why PR 100207 fields were removed).
- Source of truth stays `Team.event_retention_months`, read through `events_retention_months_for_team` in posthog/models/team/event_retention.py (HogQL floor and ClickHouse ETL read it there too).
- Endpoint is a `viewsets.ViewSet` with only `list`, so writes return 405; keep it read-only.
- `retained_from` must be computed in the project's timezone via `events_retention_floor_date(team, months)` (test covers UTC and Pacific/Auckland).
applies: Events retention API and anything surfacing the retention window to callers or the UI
